items.headline: Avalanche Tranche Vault Drained of $1M in Flash Loan Attack
items.summary: A flash loan let an attacker mint inflated tranche shares and drain a vault on $AVAX for 1.01M USDC. Blockaid says the contract balance is now zero.

items.headline: $SKYAI Dumps Entire SOL Treasury, Launches $201M Buyback
items.summary: $SKYAI sold its full Solana treasury and opened a $201M tender offer to buy back tokens — one of the biggest cash buyback moves this cycle.

items.headline: Solflare Validator Halts Rewards After Security Incident
items.summary: A Solflare validator with ~1.56M $SOL staked stopped earning rewards after a provider security incident. User funds are safe; an in-app migration is coming.

items.headline: $CC Network Tops $155M in Q3 Fees, CertiK Reports
items.summary: Canton Network's $CC ecosystem keeps quietly dominating fee rankings, logging over $155M in Q3 fees per CertiK — outpacing most major chains.

items.headline: Robinhood Chain Hits $15B in Stock Token Volume on $ARB
items.summary: Robinhood's Arbitrum-based L2 passed 100 days with $15B in stock token trades and 200K holders, with ~$1.1B deposited via Morpho. Big win for the $ARB ecosystem.
